options.text: Keep working and report it at the end of shift

questions.title: Assessment · Special Situations
questions.question: On steep slopes you should always travel straight up or straight down, never across.

completion.heading: Manual & Theory Complete
completion.body: You have read every module of the BBM Scraper Operating Manual and answered the theory questions along the way. Press Start Assessment to review your result and complete your declaration and sign-off.
